import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import OrdinalEncoder
import lightgbm as lgb
import os
import gc

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data from input directory as specified in Data Overview
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Define columns
id_col = "id"
target_col = "target"
cat_cols = ["f_27"]
num_cols = [c for c in train.columns if c not in [id_col, target_col, "f_27"]]

print(f"Total features: {len(num_cols)} numerical, 1 categorical")

# Separate features
X_train = train[num_cols + cat_cols].copy()
y_train = train[target_col]
X_test = test[num_cols + cat_cols].copy()

# Convert categorical to ordered categories (handle high cardinality)
encoder = OrdinalEncoder()
X_train[cat_cols] = encoder.fit_transform(X_train[cat_cols])
X_test[cat_cols] = encoder.transform(X_test[cat_cols])

# Engineer interactions - pairwise products for numerical features
interaction_features = []
n_num = len(num_cols)
for i in range(n_num):
    for j in range(i + 1, n_num):
        feat_name = f"{num_cols[i]}_{num_cols[j]}"
        X_train[feat_name] = X_train[num_cols[i]] * X_train[num_cols[j]]
        X_test[feat_name] = X_test[num_cols[i]] * X_test[num_cols[j]]
        interaction_features.append(feat_name)

# Add ratio interactions for first few numerics vs last few
ratio_features = []
for i in range(min(5, n_num)):
    for j in range(max(5, min(10, n_num)), n_num):
        feat_name = f"{num_cols[i]}_{num_cols[j]}_div"
        X_train[feat_name] = X_train[num_cols[i]] / (X_train[num_cols[j]] + 1e-8)
        X_test[feat_name] = X_test[num_cols[i]] / (X_test[num_cols[j]] + 1e-8)
        ratio_features.append(feat_name)

# Convert to numpy arrays while preserving feature names
feature_names = num_cols.copy() + cat_cols + interaction_features + ratio_features
n_features = len(feature_names)

X_train_arr = X_train.values.astype(np.float32)
X_test_arr = X_test.values.astype(np.float32)
y_train_arr = y_train.values.astype(np.float32)

# Genuine train/val split (80/20), will NOT be refit
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_arr, y_train_arr, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

X_tr_info = X_val.shape[1], X_val.shape[0]

print(f"Training samples: {X_tr.shape[0]}, Validation samples: {X_val.shape[0]}")
print(f"Feature count: {n_features}")

# Create LightGBM datasets with feature names (not from numpy arrays!)
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr, feature_name=feature_names)
valid_data = lgb.Dataset(
    X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data, feature_name=feature_names
)

params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 128,
    "max_depth": 10,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "reg_alpha": 0.1,
    "reg_lambda": 0.1,
    "seed": 42,
    "verbose": -1,
}

# Train model with early stopping
model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[valid_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50, verbose=False), lgb.log_evaluation(period=0)],
)

best_iter = model.best_iteration
print(f"Best iteration: {best_iter}")

# Evaluate on VALIDATION set (genuine hold-out)
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=best_iter)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Generate predictions on TEST set
test_preds = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=best_iter)

# Create submission file with exact format from sample_submission
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": sample_submission["id"], "target": test_preds})
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
